opening: I've been feeling sick to my stomach.
It's been going on for about a month.
The nausea and vomiting started 5 days ago.
For about a month I haven't had much appetite.
I've lost 6 kg over the past month without trying.
Over the past month I've had occasional vague belly pain.
I've had an underactive thyroid for 17 years.
Several months ago I switched from levothyroxine to animal thyroid extract.
A week ago I started trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, 160 mg twice a day.
